state_fields.source_coverage: Ordered disjoint core message ranges processed; context overlap is not new coverage
state_fields.processed_until_message_id: Last contiguous processed source message, nullable before first chunk
state_fields.previous_state_hash: Hash of prior accepted state; state updates remain auditable
state_fields.first_operator_ref: Source message ID of first human operator response, including relevant client-language refs
state_fields.initially_known_facts: Claims with source IDs and origin; do not invent the policy meaning of 'initially'
state_fields.identity_events: Separate request/confirmation/protected-action candidates; preserve order, scope, roles and uncertainty
state_fields.request_answer_graph: Many-to-many substantial question/answer/next-step links and open questions
state_fields.waiting_events: Wait notice/promise/return links; no invented SLA threshold
state_fields.complaint_response_links: Complaint or inconvenience and subsequent operator acknowledgement/action
state_fields.closure_events: Final turns, goodbye, offer/summary, interruption, system-close and text after close
state_fields.factual_claims: Operator claims distinguished from independently verified company facts; versioned source refs
state_fields.event_ledger: Append-only observations and interpretation revisions, no deletion of source occurrence
state_fields.criterion_states: Keyed by IDs in checklist snapshot; never hardcode exactly eight for future checklists
state_fields.unresolved_questions: Pending factual/rubric/ASR uncertainties, with affected criteria and required source

criterion_state.candidate_value: One of this criterion's allowed_values OR null before resolved
criterion_state.applicability_reason: Rule-grounded reason; insufficient context is not N/A

event_revision_fields.event_id: Stable source-derived ID; overlap duplicates collapse
event_revision_fields.observation_kind: Versioned event taxonomy; not a final criterion score
event_revision_fields.source_refs: Message IDs / spans and exact quotes
event_revision_fields.correction_of_event_id: Nullable link; does not erase occurrence of confirmed prior disclosure/offer

final_criterion_fields.final_value: Allowed enum/scale value from that criterion only; null belongs to unresolved run, not completed review
final_criterion_fields.explanation: Concise rule application, in Russian for current app
final_criterion_fields.evidence: Zero or more Evidence items if checked_ranges supply valid support
final_criterion_fields.checked_ranges: Inclusive source ranges for absence/applicability/whole-dialogue review
final_criterion_fields.na_reason: Required iff final_value is na; must invoke that criterion's actual na_rule
final_criterion_fields.uncertainties: Limitations; decisive missing fact prevents fabricated final score

Evidence_fields.criterion_id: Parent ID; final_value inherited from parent, added to flattened export by server
Evidence_fields.message_id: Existing original ID; nullable for range-only support, omission needs expected_at
Evidence_fields.original_timestamp: Server-enriched exact source string, not a generated time
Evidence_fields.speaker: Server-enriched original role; no crediting bot as operator
Evidence_fields.exact_quote: Nonempty exact source substring for positive observation; null for omission
Evidence_fields.span_utf16: Nullable {start,end}; half-open UTF-16 units, unambiguous occurrence within message
Evidence_fields.rule_ref: Checklist snapshot hash + criterion ID + relevant rule/scale/NA clause
Evidence_fields.rule_link_explanation: Why observation/range supports this outcome; not just a repeated quote
Evidence_fields.expected_at: For omission: existing anchor message/range where action was expected
Evidence_fields.checked_range: For omission/absence: inclusive from_message_id/to_message_id and expected_action
Evidence_fields.domain_source_refs: Versioned verified company references if claiming factual correctness
Evidence_fields.uncertainties: ASR/anonymisation, ambiguous applicability, missing company rule or other limitation

semantic_invariants: Never average chunk scores or sum provisional values
Each source message has exactly one core owner; overlap is read-only context
Final judge sees all original messages plus current checklist and verified reference
Pending/unknown is not na/no; numeric rubric steps remain numeric
Identification request is not confirmation; preserve confirmation-before-action chronology and scope
Later evidence can reject an earlier mistaken interpretation; a real past violation is not erased by a correction
Quote existence does not establish relevance, sufficiency or company-policy truth
Omission has no quote of absence; use expected_at and all relevant checked ranges
Final-value validation, allowed N/A and existing evidence_policy remain authoritative from checklist snapshot
Source timestamps/speaker are taken from transcript; no inferred audio offset from ISO time
Repeated quote occurrences must resolve unambiguously before UI highlighting
Final score is computed once in existing scoring code; gross-error flag is separate for current checklist
Classifier labels/scores are untrusted suggestions and omitted in H_hidden judge input
Source text/roles/times and hashes are immutable across appeals; original AI and reviewed-final views stay distinct
